jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Sciences
jobs.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

Job Title
: Associate Director, Data Sciences

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Work Model:
Hybrid

Who We Are 

It all started with a classic story about one developer’s vision. In 1995, Carl Rodrigues, President and CEO of SOTI, has developed solutions for managing mobile device screens from a desktop. An innovation that has put him ahead in what is now one of the largest growing markets – Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM). Today, more than 17,000 enterprise customers around the world depend on us to secure, manage, and support their mobile operations, with millions of devices managed worldwide.

SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. We are deeply committed to researching and developing solutions that address today’s toughest mobility challenges. We strive to go where nobody has gone before.

What’s In It for You? 

The People - From our humble origins in our founder’s basement to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.  

The Growth - Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big! 

The Technology - You’ll get the chance to work with leading-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies. 

What We’re Looking For

As Associate Director of Data Sciences, you will spearhead the strategic direction of AI and data intelligence initiatives at SOTI, transforming complex data challenges into enterprise-wide innovations that drive competitive advantage and long-term growth.

Reporting to senior leadership, you'll oversee the evolution of our data science capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives while mentoring high-calibre teams to deliver transformative AI solutions.

What You’ll Do

Spearhead the Data Science function responsible for developing and delivering AI-driven capabilities across SOTI’s product portfolio.
Define, execute, and continually refine the enterprise-wide AI strategy, integrating machine learning, advanced analytics, and data intelligence to optimize product capabilities, enhance customer outcomes, and boost operational efficiency across SOTI’s global portfolio.
Stay current with emerging developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning and translate them into practical innovations that strengthen SOTI’s competitive position.
Partner closely with Product Management and Development teams to embed predictive insights, anomaly detection, and automation into SOTI One product constituents.
Guide and mentor a team of data scientists and ML engineers, fostering a culture of experimentation, innovation, and delivery excellence.
Drive the development of scalable machine learning pipelines and data platforms capable of processing large-scale device telemetry and operational data.
Collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize models in production environments using modern MLOps practices.
Proactively identify and prioritize AI opportunities through market analysis and stakeholder alignment, leveraging analytics for advanced product intelligence, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and actionable operational insights that deliver measurable ROI for enterprise customers.
Advise executive leadership on AI trends, risks, and investment priorities, crafting roadmaps that align data science initiatives with SOTI’s long-term business goals and regulatory landscape.

Experience You’ll Bring

Graduate degree in computer science, software engineering, applied mathematics, data science, statistics, or other related field
10+ years in analytics, data science, or related fields, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing cross-functional teams and strategic AI implementations.
Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex analytical concepts into product value.
Proven experience delivering machine learning capabilities within production SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and modern AI techniques including supervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and deep learning.
Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, including developing AI roadmaps, budgeting for data science initiatives, and evaluating partnerships or acquisitions to accelerate innovation.
Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services.
Experience building production-grade ML pipelines including model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience working with large telemetry datasets, distributed data processing systems, or real-time analytics platforms is considered an asset.

About SOTI

SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provides the tools organizations need to mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments.

SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.

At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to the market. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

SOTI uses AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing resumes, screening qualifications, and creating interview questions. These tools assist our team only-final hiring decisions are made by people, not automation. For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@soti.net
.

We are committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the requirements under the Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please notify People & Culture at careers@soti.net
.

Please note that SOTI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Services Agreement with agency/recruiter, SOTI will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee.

jobs.title: Director, Global Fraud Technology- Fraud Response
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 264922

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

The Global Fraud Technology team develops and manages enterprise fraud response capabilities that enable Scotiabank to rapidly investigate, contain, and remediate fraud across all products, channels, and geographies. We partner closely with Fraud Operations, Contact Centres, Payments, Digital Banking, Risk Management, Corporate Security, AML, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver industry-leading fraud response solutions that protect customers while minimizing operational friction.

As part of Global Technology, we are responsible for the platforms, workflows, integrations, and operational tooling that support fraud investigations, case management, customer intervention, account controls, scam response, recovery processes, and fraud operations effectiveness.

The Role

The Director, Global Fraud Technology – Fraud Response is accountable for the strategy, delivery, modernization, and operation of the Bank’s fraud response technology ecosystem. This role leads teams responsible for fraud case management platforms, workflow orchestration, investigator tooling, customer remediation capabilities, operational decisioning, fraud recovery processes, and fraud operations enablement technologies.

The Director works closely with Fraud Operations leadership to define and execute the future-state operating model for fraud response, ensuring technology investments improve customer outcomes, investigator productivity, fraud containment effectiveness, and operational efficiency.

The role ensures business strategies, plans, and initiatives are executed in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies, security standards, and enterprise technology frameworks.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the multi-year fraud response technology strategy and roadmap aligned with enterprise fraud objectives.
Define the target-state fraud response ecosystem, including case management, workflow automation, customer intervention, scam response, fraud recovery, and investigator enablement capabilities.
Partner with Fraud Operations, Contact Centres, Payments, Digital Banking, and Risk teams to identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness and customer experience.
Lead modernization initiatives that transform manual processes into intelligent, automated, and scalable workflows.
Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and operating models for fraud response platforms globally.
Drive strategic vendor relationships and technology partnerships supporting fraud operations capabilities.

Fraud Operations Enablement

Own the technology platforms supporting fraud investigations and fraud operations teams globally.
Deliver capabilities that improve investigator efficiency, decision consistency, and operational effectiveness.
Enable end-to-end workflow orchestration across fraud alerts, investigations, customer outreach, account restrictions, recovery activities, and case resolution.
Partner with operational leaders to optimize investigator experiences and reduce operational complexity.
Establish technology capabilities that support workload management, prioritization, escalation, and performance monitoring.

Case Management & Workflow Platforms

Own the strategy and evolution of enterprise fraud case management capabilities.
Lead implementation and modernization of workflow platforms supporting fraud investigations and response processes.
Ensure seamless integration between fraud detection systems, operational workflows, customer servicing platforms, and core banking systems.
Drive workflow automation initiatives to reduce manual effort and accelerate fraud response times.
Enable real-time decision execution, case routing, escalation management, and operational controls.

Customer Protection & Scam Response

Lead technology capabilities supporting customer intervention and fraud containment activities.
Deliver solutions that enable rapid account protection, payment holds, transaction blocking, account recovery, and customer notification processes.
Partner with business stakeholders to enhance scam response and customer protection capabilities.
Support development of customer-facing fraud response experiences across digital and assisted channels.
Improve customer remediation journeys while balancing fraud prevention and customer experience objectives.

Data, Analytics & Operational Intelligence

Deliver operational intelligence capabilities that provide visibility into fraud response effectiveness, workload trends, investigator performance, and customer outcomes.
Enable integration of fraud detection signals into operational response workflows.
Support advanced analytics, prioritization models, and intelligent case routing capabilities.
Establish performance measurement frameworks and reporting capabilities across fraud operations platforms.
Leverage AI and automation technologies to improve investigation effectiveness and operational productivity.

Risk, Governance & Compliance

Ensure fraud response technologies operate within the Bank’s risk appetite and governance framework.
Establish controls supporting regulatory requirements, privacy obligations, customer protection standards, and operational risk management.
Partner with Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, and Corporate Security teams to maintain effective governance and oversight.
Ensure operational resiliency, disaster recovery readiness, and business continuity capabilities across the fraud response portfolio.
Maintain strong controls around customer-impacting actions, account restrictions, and operational decision execution.

Operational Excellence

Drive measurable improvements in fraud containment effectiveness, investigator productivity, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators, service-level objectives, operational metrics, and business outcomes.
Ensure effective production support, incident management, and platform reliability processes.
Lead technology financial management, vendor performance management, and capacity planning activities.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Talent Leadership

Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across engineering, product management, platform delivery, and operations technology.
Coach and mentor senior managers and technology leaders.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
Champion Agile delivery methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and product-oriented operating models.
Develop succession plans and long-term talent strategies for critical leadership and technical roles.

General

Champions a customer-focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge.
Understands how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.
Actively pursues effective and efficient operations in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, Code of Conduct, and Global Sales Principles while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to, and effectiveness of business controls relating to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions, conduct, and technology risk.

What You Will Bring To Succeed

Must Have

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience within enterprise technology organizations.
5+ years of experience leading fraud operations technology, investigations technology, operational workflow platforms, case management systems, or related financial crime technology functions.
5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multidisciplinary teams.
Deep understanding of fraud operations processes, fraud investigations, customer remediation, and fraud response workflows.
Experience implementing enterprise workflow, case management, and operational decisioning platforms.
Strong understanding of cloud technologies, enterprise integration patterns, APIs, event-driven architectures, and operational platforms.
Experience managing large-scale technology portfolios, budgets, strategic roadmaps, and vendor relationships.
Proven ability to drive operational transformation and workflow automation initiatives.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience operating within highly regulated financial services environments.

Nice to Have

Experience with fraud case management platforms, workflow engines, investigation tools, and operational orchestration technologies.
Experience supporting scam prevention, customer protection, and fraud recovery initiatives.
Knowledge of AI-assisted investigations, intelligent workflow automation, and operational analytics.
Experience with fraud operations, payments operations, contact centre technologies, or financial crime investigations.
Understanding of regulatory requirements related to fraud management, customer protection, and operational risk.
Experience leading global teams across multiple geographies.

The Workplace

We are technology partners who help the business transform how our employees around the world work.
We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
You'll get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders, who have hailed from top technology companies around the world.
We foster an environment of innovation and continuous learning.
We care about our people, allowing them to design how they work to deliver amazing results.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance

Our client is seeking a Director of Finance to join their growing organization. This newly created role will work closely with the CFO and provide senior-level oversight to the accounting function, while focusing heavily on financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, KPI reporting, and business insights. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on with the numbers and partnering with leadership, without being tied to the day-to-day transactional accounting.

The organization is also pursuing further acquisitions, giving this role the opportunity to play an important part in acquisition integration, evolving financial reporting processes, and ultimately supporting consolidated reporting as the business grows. The ideal candidate will bring a CPA designation, 5+ years of progressive finance experience, strong Excel and financial modelling skills, and experience with ASPE.

Key Responsibilities

Provide senior-level financial oversight and act as a key resource to the CFO and accounting team.
Review monthly financial reporting and month-end workbooks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Provide guidance to the accounting team on complex accounting matters and one-off issues.
Lead the year-end process and coordinate with external accountants and advisors.
Prepare and maintain financial models to support business planning, decision-making, and strategic initiatives.
Lead the annual budgeting process and ongoing monthly forecasting.
Perform monthly variance analysis and provide explanations and insights into financial performance.
Develop and monitor financial KPIs and provide analysis to management.
Prepare quarterly financial reporting packages and support bank reporting requirements.
Review and improve internal controls, accounting processes, and financial reporting procedures.
Support acquisition activities, including financial analysis, integration of acquired businesses, and development of appropriate reporting processes.
Assist with the transition from single-entity reporting toward consolidated financial reporting as the organization expands.
Partner with the CFO and operational leaders to provide financial insight and support informed business decisions.
Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, processes, systems, and overall efficiency.
Provide financial analysis and support for special projects and other strategic initiatives as required.

Qualifications

CPA designation is required.
Minimum 5 years of progressive finance and accounting experience, ideally including experience in a senior financial leadership, FP&A, or corporate accounting capacity.
Strong understanding of financial reporting and accounting principles; experience with ASPE is required.
Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and variance analysis.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to build and maintain financial models.
Experience reviewing month-end and year-end financial reporting and working with external accountants.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate financial information into meaningful business insights.
Experience with acquisitions, integration, or consolidated reporting would be an asset.
Strong understanding of internal controls and financial processes.
Experience with ERP systems; experience with Visual ERP would be an asset.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both accounting and operational stakeholders.
Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and provide sound judgment in a growing organization.

Director of Finance

Our client is seeking an experienced Director of Finance to lead and transform its finance and accounting function across a complex North American organization.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a CPA who combines enterprise-level leadership with strong operational execution. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of leading large, geographically dispersed teams of 25+ employees, driving finance transformation, and strengthening financial controls, processes, and governance.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical accounting expertise, including IFRS, alongside the ability to lead through other leaders while remaining hands-on in identifying issues, improving processes, and implementing sustainable change.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

Lead the finance and accounting function across a complex, multi-entity North American organization.
Oversee financial reporting, consolidations, month-end close, statutory reporting, and external audits in accordance with IFRS.
Establish consistent accounting policies, reporting standards, and financial governance across the organization.
Partner with executive leadership to provide financial insight and support strategic decision-making.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

Lead enterprise-wide initiatives to standardize, streamline, and modernize finance processes, systems, and reporting.
Assess existing processes, organizational structures, and controls, identifying gaps and implementing practical, scalable improvements.
Strengthen internal controls, financial governance, and risk management practices across entities and business units.
Maintain a hands-on approach to problem-solving, working directly with teams to improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and accountability.
Drive continuous improvement, automation, and effective change management while maintaining business continuity.

Leadership & Business Partnership

Lead, develop, and mentor a large, geographically dispersed finance organization, including developing managers and strengthening leadership capability.
Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and organizational structures that support business objectives.
Partner with operations, supply chain, IT, and other functional leaders to improve financial visibility, costing accuracy, inventory controls, and working capital.
Build a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating financial and operational performance into actionable business insights.

Qualifications & Experience

CPA designation required.
15+ years of progressive finance and accounting leadership experience, including senior leadership at the Corporate Controller, VP Finance, or equivalent level.
Demonstrated success leading large accounting and finance teams across multiple locations and geographies, with experience developing leaders and managing through others.
Strong technical accounting expertise, including extensive IFRS experience and multi-entity financial consolidation.
Proven experience leading finance transformation, process standardization, and internal control improvements across a complex organization.
Experience assessing organizational structures, developing talent, and leading teams through significant change.
Strong executive presence, commercial acumen, and the ability to influence stakeholders across finance and operations.

new_jobs.title: Data & Analytics Leader- Consulting/Managing Partner) (CDO Like )  : Toronto, ON : Hybrid
new_jobs.description:
Job Role : Data & Analytics Leader- Consulting/Managing Partner) (CDO Like )

Location : Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Experience: 18+ years of experience

Job Type : Full time Permanent

Salary range : CAD $ 140 K/Base +Benifts.

• Experience Range:
18+ years of experience in Data, Analytics & AI, including 10+ years in Data/Application Architecture and 5+ years in Business Development, Presales, Consulting or Growth Leadership roles.

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills:

18+ years of experience in Data, Analytics, AI, Consulting, and Enterprise Data Transformation, with proven success in business growth and large-scale transformation programs.
• Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Strategy, Data Architecture, Operating Models, Data Products, Data Governance, and Data Modernization
• Proven experience in delivering ROI and Business Outcomes to customers across the Data to Insights value chain
• Demonstrates deeper understanding of Data Engineering, including ETL/ELT, data integration, APIs, data quality, orchestration, observability, DataOps, and platform engineering.
• Experience leading Analytics and Business Intelligence initiatives, including enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, semantic layers, advanced analytics, and decision intelligence.
• Strong knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI, and AI-driven business transformation.
• Proven experience defining and delivering enterprise-scale solutions on Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.
• Strong understanding of BFSI domain requirements, including regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, resilience, auditability, and risk management.
• Demonstrated success in consulting, business development, pre-sales, solutioning, opportunity qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and executive-level stakeholder management.
• Proven ability to lead large cross-functional teams, drive transformation programs, and engage effectively with CXOs and senior business leaders.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data, Business, or a related discipline.
• Master's Degree or MBA preferred.
• Preferred certifications in Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data Management, Analytics, AI, Program Management, or Executive Leadership.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Build trusted relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CAIOs, business executives, and senior technology leaders.
• Advise BFSI clients on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, governance, operating models, and modernization priorities.
• Translate business challenges into practical transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, steering committee discussions, and strategic client conversations.
• Drive growth for Data, Analytics & AI services from opportunity identification and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
• Shape large consulting and transformation engagements, including solution direction, value proposition, commercial approach, and delivery roadmap.
• Lead RFPs and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, feasible, and outcome-focused.
• Build joint opportunities with account teams, alliance partners, technology providers, and consulting practices.
• Define target-state strategies across cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, governance, and responsible AI.
• Recommend practical modernization approaches across Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and other relevant platforms.
• Ensure transformation decisions address scalability, security, privacy, resilience, cost, and regulatory requirements.
• Provide executive oversight from opportunity shaping and mobilization through delivery and value realization.
• Establish governance across scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, commercial commitments, quality, and stakeholder communication.
• Ensure a structured transition from presales to delivery with clear commitments, success measures, and ownership.
• Lead and mentor consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and AI teams across locations.
• Support senior talent hiring, capability development, succession planning, and mentoring.
• Develop reusable offerings, reference architectures, case studies, estimators, executive narratives, and delivery playbooks.
• Represent the practice with clients, partners, and internal leadership as a trusted voice for BFSI Data, Analytics & AI transformation.

• Generic Managerial Skills, If any

Strong executive leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with CXOs, business leaders, and technology teams.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills across business, technical, and executive audiences.
• Strong consulting and strategic thinking capabilities with the ability to drive business outcomes and transformation initiatives.
• Proven ability to lead large cross-functional and global teams across consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and delivery functions.
• Strong business acumen with experience in growth strategy, opportunity development, solutioning, and executive decision-making.
• High ownership, accountability, integrity, and commitment to delivering successful client outcomes.
• Experience mentoring senior leaders, architects, and consultants while building high-performing teams and future capabilities.
• Ability to manage multiple strategic priorities, complex stakeholder landscapes, and large transformation programs.
• Strong governance, risk management, and escalation management skills across large-scale engagements.
Adaptability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments with evolving business priorities and emerging technologies.
